Lucero — Madrid, Spain

Higher caution advised day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Lucero has the strongest press documentation in Latina district for recent, serious safety issues. Multiple 2024 reports describe entrenched narcopisos on and around a specific street, with a resident quoted saying conditions amount to 'terror, day, morning and night.' Police carried out a large raid in November 2020 (30 arrests) and a further macro-operation in September 2024 (around 40 arrests), yet the underlying problem reportedly persisted afterward. Sources checked: Cuatro.com, May 2024; Telemadrid, May 2024; Telecinco/El Espanol, Sept 2024; Guiadealuche.net, Nov 2020.
